2026 buyer guide for security and risk teams

How to compare AI security controls

A risk register, a content filter and a runtime inspection tool answer different questions. Map your data path first, then buy the control that covers the gap.

Compare 10 options ↓

What to ask before you buy

  1. Draw where prompts, files and responses go, including logs, backups and subprocessors.
  2. Test the proposed policy with a synthetic sensitive record. Check the audit event and who can read it.
  3. Exercise an outage and a deletion request. Record what fails closed and what remains in storage.

Trace a test document through an AI service

Use a synthetic document to check access, retention and deletion before employees upload customer files.

Directory

Each product has published material on a specific control. Inclusion describes that scope. Security outcomes depend on configuration, coverage and your own evaluation.

Data posture

Microsoft Purview

Provides data security posture management. Check which data sources and licenses the proposed configuration covers.

Source from Microsoft Purview

Model inputs and outputs

Google Cloud Model Armor

Screens interactions with models. Test its behavior with representative inputs and document what gets logged.

Source from Google Cloud Model Armor

Model safeguards

Amazon Bedrock Guardrails

Applies configurable safeguards to model interactions. Measure false positives on your own support or sales vocabulary.

Source from Amazon Bedrock Guardrails

Application guardrails

NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails

Offers a library for adding guardrails to language-model applications. Budget engineering time for evaluation and maintenance.

Source from NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails

Runtime security

Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS

Documents security controls for AI applications. Ask where traffic is inspected and how the service handles an outage.

Source from Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS

Deployment architecture

Cisco AI Defense

Publishes a reference architecture for AI Defense on Cisco AI PODs. Compare its inspection points with your network design.

AI governance

IBM watsonx.governance

Gateway observability

Cloudflare AI Gateway

AI governance

Credo AI

How to compare prices

Request separate estimates for inspections, log storage, governance seats and implementation. Estimate the cost of retaining evidence for your required audit period.

A worked example to review

Cisco publishes an AI Defense reference architecture for its AI PODs. Use the architecture to compare inspection points with your own model deployment.

Read the provider’s example

Does buying a guardrail make an AI deployment compliant?

A guardrail covers a specific interaction. Your team still needs to establish lawful access, retention, review ownership and evidence for its applicable requirements.
